itemUsage.en: Alanna, barrens truck driver and Rhodes Island Artificer, doesn't see much of a difference between the two jobs—both involve screws and spanners, after all.
itemUsage.zh: 荒野上的运载车驾驶员，罗德岛的工匠，阿兰娜觉得这两份工作都是和螺丝扳手打交道，本质并无不同。

itemDesc.en: Why does she insist on wielding such a big spanner? Because she's got some big pipes to install!
itemDesc.zh: 为什么她要用一把这么大的管钳？当然是因为她真有这么粗的管子需要去拧！

description.en: Rolling Wheels Issue 752 Two truck drivers enter a bar. One says: 'I had some right terrible luck today. Ran into bandits again, and gave the steering wheel a good jerk to shake 'em off, but they still managed to scratch my truck.' The other says: 'Don't come crying to me just 'cause they nicked your paint. They ruined both my bumpers!' 'Both of 'em?' the first driver asks. 'Some sorta pincer attack?' 'You think I'd still be here talking if they did?' The other driver ties her hair back up again. 'They went and bloody intercepted my truck from the front.' 'Then how'd they ruin both bumpers?' 'The stuff I got for self-defense was getting fixed up at the shop, so I had to tear off my back bumper and give them a few good whacks with it. Good thing the folks at the police station gave me some dosh as a reward for handing them in, or else I'd be skint!' 'Who the hell approved such a crappy joke for publication?!' A man with black eyes spits on the ground as he turns the page. 'Stop reading that shitty rag already and get back to work.' One of his colleagues knocks the magazine out of his hands with a steel pipe and thrusts some barbed wire at him. 'You know the drill, lay it out 500 meters ahead.' The man throws a filthy towel over his head, picks up the wire and follows the road. 'Dammit, why am I only allowed to set up the first trap? Even if we do pop some tires and snag a car, I'd still only get the smallest share. And if the tires don't pop and the car gets away, I'm always the one who gets a beating!' The man's hands never stop even as he shouts his sorrows, and soon, the road is covered in crude but effective spike strips. Out in the distance, a cloud of dust is kicked up. A car's coming. The man with blackened eye sockets looks at the oncoming vehicle, dumbfounded. The truck's a real battered one. Even the front bumper's barely hanging on by a thread. The metaphorical thread, in this case, is a giant spanner, bigger than any he's seen before. The man starts running back towards his gang, yelling as he goes: 'It's her! It's bloody her again! 'That bloody sheila's back to make some more money!'
description.zh:
《车轮滚滚》第752期
两名运载车驾驶员走进一家酒吧。
其中一个人说：“我今天运气真差，又遇上了劫路匪帮，还好我一把方向盘躲了过去，但我的车身还是被他们刮花了。”
另一个人说：“刮掉一点车漆而已，你就别倒苦水啦。我可是被他们弄坏了两根保险杠呢！”
“两根？”第一个驾驶员问，“他们同时从前后两面夹击你的车子？”
“怎么可能？那样他们也会没命的。”另一个驾驶员重新绑起她的头发，“他们从前面截停了我的车。”
“那怎么会同时弄坏两根保险杠呢？”
“我的防身武器送去修了，只好将后保险杠拆下来，把他们揍了一顿。还好扭送他们到治安官手上让我拿了些奖金，不然那才叫亏大了呢！”

“这么烂的笑话，谁批准刊载的？”顶着黑眼圈的男人往地上啐了一口，顺手把杂志翻过一页。
“别看你那破书了，来活了。”同伙一钢管将杂志打落在地，往男人怀里塞了一捆带刺的铁丝，“老规矩，往前五百米，铺上。”
男人蒙上脏兮兮的面巾，拎起那捆铁丝沿着道路往前走去。
“去他的，我只配来铺第一道关吗？就算扎破轮胎，车子停了，我分到的也是最少的那一份。可要是扎不破轮胎让车子跑了，挨打的总是我！”
男人说着话，手上动作不停，简陋却有效的减速带很快铺满了这段路面。远处尘烟升起，车子来了。
眼眶乌黑的男人看着来车，愣了一下。
那辆运载车看起来破破烂烂的，就连前保险杠都已经摇摇欲坠——将它固定在车头的，是一把巨大无比的管钳。
男人拔腿向着后方的同伙跑去，一边跑一边喊：
“又是她！又是她！
“那个女人又来赚外快了！”
